limits: Stack is exercised M23 code on M33 QEMU, not worst-case or hardware timing.
Only 512 valid ordered samples and one invalid-dt/quarantine control; no long-run approximation qualification.
One final 16-coordinate point transport comparison and SOC formula check; no validated uncertainty.
No IPC, snapshots, asynchronous host installation, origin recovery, host memory image or shared-SRAM implementation.
Validated immutable configuration, nonaliasing live arrays and serialized ownership remain caller contracts.
Every variant exceeds 10240B even before full platform integration.
